regions.tonight: A dry evening and a dry start to the night before rain develops later. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A rather wet start to the day, though the rain will become patchier and more intermittent during the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 16 to 21 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Wednesday. Low on Thursday.
